scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply chinapoll-local --local --persist-to .wrangler
scripts.deploy:admin:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply chinapoll --env production --remote && npx wrangler deploy --config admin/wrangler.toml --env production
scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate && npm run build && (npm run dev:web:serve & npx wrangler dev worker/index.ts --local --persist-to .wrangler --port 8787 --live-reload=false & wait)
scripts.dev:web: npm run build && npm run dev:web:serve
scripts.dev:worker: npm run db:migrate && npx wrangler dev worker/index.ts --local --persist-to .wrangler --port 8787 --live-reload=false
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply chinapoll --env production --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate:remote && npx wrangler deploy --env production

SERVER_HMAC_KEY.description: Required 64-hex server secret for keyed network hashing and for poll/comment ownership. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`, then SAVE IT somewhere outside Cloudflare (a password manager or secret vault): Cloudflare never displays a stored secret again, and this value is the only input to every poll and comment owner hash, so losing it permanently prevents any existing poll or comment from being matched to its author. See docs/RUNBOOK.md.
